ro: You are viewing the organisation's AI configuration read-only. You can still manage your own AI keys in section 4.
roViewer: You are viewing the organisation's AI configuration read-only.
s1sub: Choose where data is sent for analysis. You can change it any time; applies to the next analyses.
mLocalD: Ollama only. Source code and results never leave your network.
mHybridD: Ollama scores first; only important or uncertain findings go to the cloud.
mCloudD: Every analysis uses cloud AI. Most accurate, costs money, data leaves the host.
featNote: Pentest Agent always needs a tool-calling model: Local/Hybrid use Ollama if the model passes the tool-calling check, otherwise the cloud (Local refuses instead of silently switching to the cloud).
s2sub: The machine running local models: this host, the Docker host, or another machine on the LAN.
olUrlHint: Empty = system default ({def}) · http(s) only, no redirects.
olModelHint: Only installed models are listed. A saved-but-missing model shows a red warning instead of silently picking another.
missingModel: The saved model "{m}" is not installed on Ollama. Pull it or pick another one — nothing is switched automatically.
ckNone: Not checked yet. Press "Test" next to the Ollama address.
ckBridge: Tool-calling / JSON: cannot be checked yet (backend not updated).
ck2no: Model not installed or not responding
ck3: Tool-calling: called a probe tool (usable for Pentest Agent)
ck3noL: Tool-calling: NOT supported — Pentest Agent will be refused in Local mode
ck3noH: Tool-calling: NOT supported — Pentest Agent will use the cloud
ck4: JSON output: {bad}/{n} malformed — prefer a ≥7B model
pullHint: Suggested: qwen2.5:7b (good tool-calling) · qwen2.5-coder:7b (code) · llava (images). Pulling needs Internet on the Ollama host.
delConfirm: Delete model "{m}"? You will need to pull it again to use it.
s2b: Hybrid rules: what goes to the cloud
s2bsub: A finding goes to the cloud if ANY condition below matches. Otherwise the Ollama result is kept.
hSevHint: Severe findings are always re-checked by the cloud.
hBandHint: 0% = surely a real bug · 100% = surely a false positive.
t3: Document summaries / Document Review / File Assistant
hPreviewTxt: ≈ {n}/{total} findings would go to the cloud ({pct}%)
hPreviewNone: No preview yet (needs a recent scan with Ollama results).
hPreviewHint: Counted by rule only, no AI call. See the usage log for actual cost.
s3sub: Shared key managed by ADMIN. Used when a user has no own key (if policy allows) and for system jobs.
envNote: Uses credentials already present on the server (environment or login session). Nothing secret is stored in VulnGuard.
brChain: Host credential chain (IAM role / env / default profile)
brProfile: AWS profile logged in on the server (aws sso login)
brProfileHint: Log in on the server first with aws sso login --profile <name>, then enter the profile name. Note: kiro-cli login only signs in to Kiro; it does not create an AWS profile for Bedrock.
modelsApi: {n} models fetched from the API with the saved key.
modelsStatic: Default list ({n}) — you can still type another model.
keyDelConfirm: Remove the saved {p} key from the server?
testL: Test (uses form values, no need to save first)
testDirtyBridge: The backend can only test the SAVED configuration. Press Save first, then test.
privacy: Privacy when sending to the cloud
pv1: Send code context to the cloud
pvWarn: When on, code around the finding is sent to {p}. Make sure your organisation's data policy allows it.
advHint: The PENTEST_LLM_*_MODEL environment variables (if set) always win over these values.
s4sub: Your own keys, used for analyses and pentests YOU start. Only you can use them; admins only see whether you have one.
policyNote: Org policy: {byok} · Allowed providers: {prov} · Without an own key: {fb}.
policyNoteNA: Organisation policy is not available yet.
mineUnavail: Personal keys are not available yet: the server does not support them (waiting for the backend update). You keep using the org key as before.
mineError: Could not load your keys. Try reloading the page.
saveHint: The key is checked with one tiny call before saving. Encrypted on receipt; never shown again.
label: Label (optional)
keyDelOwnConfirm: Remove this key? Jobs pinned to it will stop with a clear error.
errOauth: Claude.ai subscription tokens (sk-ant-oat…) are not accepted. Create an API key in the Claude Console.
kiroQ: I have a Kiro licence — can I use it?
kiroA: Kiro does not offer a model API for other apps; a Kiro licence works only inside Kiro IDE/CLI. If your company uses AWS, ask for Amazon Bedrock access (an IAM Identity Center permission set), create a personal Bedrock API key and add it here.
policyUnavail: Key policy is not available yet: the server does not support it. The fields below are locked and cannot be saved.
p1: Users may bring their own key
p2: When a user has no own key
p2b: Refuse, ask to add a key
p4: Org-key quota per user / month (empty = unlimited)
revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? The user will have to add a new one.
stModeSubL: Ollama only, data stays on the host
stMineOrgB: Your key: using the org key
stMineOrg: You have no key of your own
stMineNone: Add one in section 4 or ask an admin to enable the org key
bridge: Bridge mode: the server does not have the per-user key API (/api/ai/settings) yet. Sections 1–3 still save through the existing API; sections 4–5, testing unsaved values and the tool-calling check turn on when the backend is updated. The two old tabs (Ollama & Model, AI Provider) stay reachable.
errBand: Invalid FP% band: need 0 ≤ from ≤ to ≤ 100.
errKeyNeeded: A key is required (or pick another auth method).
errFix: Fix the highlighted errors before saving.
errOllamaUrl: Could not save the Ollama address.
loadErr: Could not load the AI settings. Try reloading the page.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Try again later.
err.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
err.unavailable: The server does not support this yet.
err.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
code.INVALID_KEY: Key rejected (401). Create a new key in the provider's console, then press Replace.
code.NO_MODEL_ACCESS: The key is valid but has no access to this model.
code.RATE_LIMITED: The provider is rate limiting. Try again later.
code.BAD_BASE_URL: Base URL is invalid or not allowed.
code.AI_NO_CREDENTIAL: No key available. Add one in section 4 or ask an admin to enable the org key.
code.AI_LOCAL_NO_TOOLS: The Ollama model does not support tool-calling.
title: AI
